question: Should conflicting Discord subagent-progress emoji be rejected during effective configuration resolution, degraded with a visible warning, or supported through shared reaction ownership?
rationale: The branch currently silently degrades running collisions and leaves failure collisions unresolved; implementation alone cannot establish the intended public operator contract.

options.title: Reject all collisions
options.body: Validate effective running and failure emoji against lifecycle and ack reactions and report a clear configuration error before runtime.

options.title: Warn and degrade
options.body: Disable only conflicting progress behavior while emitting operator-visible diagnostics and documenting the typing-only or non-durable fallback.

options.title: Coordinate ownership
options.body: Allow overlapping emoji through shared acquisition and release semantics across the status and progress controllers.

recommendation.title: Reject all collisions
recommendation.body: Validate effective running and failure emoji against lifecycle and ack reactions and report a clear configuration error before runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history connection to the shared status-reaction contract and adjacent subagent lifecycle behavior.
